productionStandards.description: Diff-only scan on every PR into develop for fast feedback; full-codebase scan on push to develop and on a weekly schedule.
Filesystem scan on every PR into develop and on push; results upload as SARIF to GitHub Code Scanning.
Every feature is covered by unit/integration tests scoped to its Acceptance Criteria (AC); all AC tests must pass before a human can merge.
Every step of the AI-DLC loop has a human decision gate — a human reviews and approves the plan, the tests, and the code before anything merges.
